digest.component_or_area: outbound-parent synchronization (CREATE emit and ACLI attach fallback)
propositions: CREATE emit path drops a non-epic parent silently with only a logger.debug, producing no durable bridge_alerts entry
ACLI attach fallback swallows HTTP 400 on parent attachment with a WARNING but no record_parent_divergence call, leaving no trace when Jira rejects the parent

Slot 2 (CREATE) and slot 4 (ACLI attach) violate the contract stated in pass_io.py:113-118 and dispatch_one.py:561-564 that an unreachable parent must leave a durable operator-visible record, not merely a log line
The epic-only parent guard is unconditional but documented as a universal standard-project rule while Data Center accepts and ignores non-epic parents rather than rejecting them with HTTP 400
An UNBOUND parent (not yet synced to Jira) must remain silent on first emit because it converges on a later pass; only BOUND non-epic parents should alert when dropped
